info.title: TikTok Comments API: Comments and Replies by Video Link, No Login
info.description:
Comments and replies under public TikTok videos as JSON.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/tiktok-comments (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Returns the comments under TikTok videos and photo posts: text, author handle, likes, reply count, the replies themselves, language and TikTok's own flags (liked by the creator, pinned, purchase intent). Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

videoUrls.title: Video links
videoUrls.description: Links to TikTok videos or photo posts. Share links (vm.tiktok.com, tiktok.com/t/…) and bare video ids work too.

videoUrl.title: Single video link
videoUrl.description: One more link, read together with the list above. Kept for integrations that send a single link.

maxComments.title: Maximum comments per video
maxComments.description: Rows to save for each video. A request returns 20 rows at most.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Also save the replies under each comment, right after the comment they answer.

maxRepliesPerComment.title: Maximum replies per comment
maxRepliesPerComment.description: Used when replies are included, so that one long discussion does not use up the whole limit.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
